# `set_test_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Change the device test/hot settings (heater, cooler, 5 GHz station, goto simulation flags).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit build; 32-bit build probable) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xc9860 (new_solve_exec stored @0xc9c24/@0xc9c28, autogoto_threshold parsed @0xc9adc and stored @0xc9c30/@0xc9c34), SetTestSetting @0x11fef0 (writes autogoto_threshold when it differs), SetHotSetting @0x120270 (64-bit build) |

Copies the current test and hot settings, applies the members that are present and correctly typed, and writes both back, persisting configuration. Six members are assigned (auto_open_heater, auto_open_cooler, station_5g, goto_simulate, new_solve_exec and autogoto_threshold). autogoto_threshold is persisted when it differs from the stored value. Booleans may be sent as integers; wrong member types are ignored silently. Other internally persisted flags not read by this call are written back as copied. plan_simulate has no setter here. autogoto_threshold is a unitless fraction of the smaller field-of-view dimension (see get_test_setting); the other flags' semantics are unresolved beyond the member names.

Side effects: Updates the operational test/hot setting globals and writes configuration files. No timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_test_setting"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Test/hot settings to change. Every member is optional; a missing or wrongly typed member is silently ignored and keeps its current value. No ranges are checked and unknown keys are ignored. There is no setter for plan_simulate here. [READ] |
| `params.new_solve_exec` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Accepted as boolean or integer and stored in the test-setting record (assigned). [READ] |
| `params.autogoto_threshold` | number | no | - | Accepted as float or integer and stored in the test-setting record (assigned); persisted when it differs from the stored value. Unitless fraction of the smaller field-of-view dimension (FOV divisor INFERRED); see get_test_setting. [READ; FOV divisor INFERRED] |
| `params.auto_open_heater` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Open the heater automatically (assigned). [READ] |
| `params.auto_open_cooler` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Open the cooler automatically (assigned). [READ] |
| `params.station_5g` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Station-mode 5 GHz flag (assigned). [READ] |
| `params.goto_simulate` | boolean\|integer | no | - | Simulate goto (assigned). [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | params absent, null or not an object | `expected object param` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

No member type or range errors are emitted. The inspected setter always reports success.

## Example

Request, heater - Enable automatic heater:

```json
{"id":50,"method":"set_test_setting","params":{"auto_open_heater":true}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_test_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":50}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_test_setting","error":"expected object param","code":107,"id":51}
```
